Package com.agrialert.api

Class ApiManager

java.lang.Object
com.agrialert.api.ApiManager
public class ApiManager extends Object
Manages API interactions for the AgriAlert application, providing centralized access to weather forecasting and geocoding services.

This class utilizes Retrofit to communicate with the Open-Meteo API for weather data and the Mapbox API for converting between physical addresses and geographic coordinates.

Key functionalities include:

  • Retrieving real-time weather forecasts based on latitude and longitude.
  • Forward geocoding: Converting an address string into geographic coordinates.
  • Reverse geocoding: Converting geographic coordinates into a human-readable address.

The class uses RxJava for asynchronous operations to ensure network calls do not block the main application thread.

  • Method Details

    • getCoordinatesFromAddress

      public static io.reactivex.rxjava3.core.Single<android.util.Pair<?,?>> getCoordinatesFromAddress(String address)
      Fetches the geographic coordinates (longitude and latitude) for a given address string. This method performs a network request to the Mapbox Geocoding API on a background thread.
      Parameters:
      address - The physical address or place name to be geocoded.
      Returns:
      A Single emitting a Pair where the first element is the longitude (Double) and the second element is the latitude (Double). If the address cannot be resolved, returns a Pair containing null values.

    • getAddressFromCoordinates

      public static io.reactivex.rxjava3.core.Single<String> getAddressFromCoordinates(double lat, double lon)
      Performs reverse geocoding to retrieve a physical address string from geographical coordinates.
      Parameters:
      lat - The latitude of the location.
      lon - The longitude of the location.
      Returns:
      A Single emitting the address as a String, or an empty string if no address is found.
